shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in an orange shirt sits in the shelf-side aisle seat and calls the meeting to order to review the weekly club contributions, a woman in a white shirt sits in the doorway-side aisle seat, a man in a blue shirt sits in the shelf-side window seat, and a woman in a yellow shirt sits in the doorway-side window seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the shelving unit in frame.

shots.content: The man in an orange shirt asks about the first report, and the woman in a white shirt explains the summary.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the window side, centered on the two adjacent aisle-side seats.

shots.content: The man in an orange shirt notes the remaining project goals.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the window side, centered on the person at the shelf-side aisle seat.

shots.content: The man in an orange shirt presents the final result, the woman in a white shirt agrees with the findings, and the man in a blue shirt confirms the club schedule.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the game table.
